errors.evidence: The description of the x-axis does not mention the interval of the tick labels, which is every 6 months (e.g., 07/2014, 01/2015).

errors.text_span: fällt im Laufe der Zeit mit mehreren Schwankungen
errors.evidence: Describing the purple line as generally falling is inaccurate. The line is highly volatile, oscillating around a mean that slightly decreases until 2020 and then generally increases.

errors.text_span: erreicht einen Tiefpunkt von etwa 30 Mrd. US-$ im Jahr 2020
errors.evidence: The most significant low point of the purple line, occurring in early 2020, drops below zero to approximately -10 to -20 Mrd. US-$. The value of 30 Mrd. US-$ is not the lowest point.

errors.text_span: liegt im Juli 2024 bei etwa 150 Mrd. US-$
errors.evidence: The final value of the purple line in July 2024 is visibly above the 150 Mrd. US-$ grid line, closer to 160 or 170 Mrd. US-$.

errors.text_span: beginnt bei etwa 800 Mrd. US-$ im Juli 2014
errors.evidence: The blue line clearly starts at 1,000 Mrd. US-$ in July 2014, not 800 Mrd. US-$.
The blue line does not rise continuously from the start. It shows a slight downward trend from 2014 to 2020 before it begins to rise sharply.
